status: FROZEN BEFORE OPENING NEW 15/30-DAY SOURCE ARRAYS; PREVIOUS ONE-DAY CLIMATE OUTCOMES ALREADY INSPECTED, THIS IS A POST-RESULT TEMPORAL SENSITIVITY, NOT INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION.
main_ecological_question: Do the 21 fixed sites' opposite temperature and shallow-soil-water trajectories at near-equal central-day photoperiod persist in the previous 15 and 30 calendar days, or were one-day contrasts mainly short-term weather?

original_source_frame.physical_grid: original_21_land_grid_sites.csv (21 unchanged preexisting sites from 72-grid static land mask)
original_source_frame.original_1day_hold: Original Iran +30,+60 2019 falling source soil moisture -0.001 m3/m3; source H0 physically invalid. Keep previous one-day output untouched.
original_source_frame.replication_units: 21 fixed nonrepresentative geographic sites in three original annual cycles; NOT 63 independent regions or global land sample.

new_time_scales.window: Trailing inclusive calendar days ending exactly on the previously fixed rising or falling matched solar day. 15 includes target and prior 14; 30 includes target and prior 29.
new_time_scales.daylight_caution: Only endpoint pair's astronomy is near-equal, NOT every calendar day in each trailing window. These characterize season history preceding a matched photoperiod endpoint; NOT equal-daily-photoperiod windows.

independent_source.provider: Open-Meteo ERA5 historical daily archive, API https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive
independent_source.spatial_sampling: same original 21 requested lat/lon points; validate actual output lat/lon and timezone per point, with 6 original sites south and 15 north
independent_source.source_data: 12 official ERA5 original 30-day daily response arrays; archive all original request URLs and fields separately for hemispheres; recover 15-day values by subsetting original 30-day data, no second provider.
independent_source.data_integrity: all 30 dates consecutive and exact, no duplicate; per day T max >= T mean; 0<=surface_moisture<=1, precipitation_sum>=0, all values finite and units exact. A missing/physically invalid day means the full 30d pair unavailable; the 15d pair may still be independently available only when its own 15 days valid. No interpolation, fill, clipping, changing model or threshold.

frozen_endpoints: For each source location/cycle and W=15,30: Δ mean of DAILY mean T, Δ mean of DAILY max T, Δ mean of DAILY surface 0–7cm volumetric water, Δ accumulated precipitation over window. All comparisons falling minus rising, not ratios.
Count source qualified pairs and hold reasons separately for W=15 and W=30, including missing and invalid physically bounded moisture.
Count warmer/drier and cooler/wetter opposite signs, warmer/wetter and cooler/drier same signs, zero moisture and zero T separately; do not drop signs.
Among pairs source-valid at W=1,15,30, count how often the day-one opposite T/moisture sign remains an opposite sign at each 15/30day scale, as well as switches/undefined.
Report each original geographic site's three annual cycles, site-mean directional signs, and whether all three annual W=30 pairs remain opposed; no site exclusion chosen on result.
Report 30-day precipitation vs soil moisture sign agreement/disagreement as exploratory hydroclimate timing only; rainfall is not plant uptake.
Use equal source site/cycle weighting for descriptive means. No p-values, standard-error pseudo replication, area-weighted global estimates, or animal-effect estimates.
ecological_interpretation_limits: One centered endpoint date per seasonal branch, multiweek history not equal daylength every day; no proof of endogenous photoperiod memory.
Temperatures, soil moisture and precipitation all from the SAME reanalysis model; not independent field sensors or causal forcing.
Source shallow soil water not root-zone resource or vegetation biomass; 30d accumulation of modeled rainfall not directly migratory or forage availability.
The prior Serengeti camera/NDVI data are from a different geography and years, without its camera hours/detection-q. Do NOT pool it as 21 observed animal site effects.
21 geographical sites were selected from a crude land mask, not area-weighted or biome-balanced; 3 years at each site autocorrelated.
Source API anomalies (such as negative moisture) must remain HOLD; do not clip small negatives or substitute 0.
acceptance: One data-source verification and science table under research/solar_global_equinoctial_pilot_20261019, with all original daily source arrays and pre-existing 1d results unchanged, one dedicated test gate and a succinct honest ecology Results update.
